other_failure_modes.description: Transformers such as imputers, scalers, TF-IDF, and TruncatedSVD are fitted on the entire training dataset before cross-validation. This leaks information from the validation folds into the training folds, compromising the integrity of the out-of-fold (OOF) scores.

other_failure_modes.name: KeyError in Feature Engineering
other_failure_modes.description: The temporal feature extraction relies on train_date_cols being present in test_parsed_dates. If a date column is entirely null or unparseable in the test set, detect_and_parse_dates will omit it, causing a KeyError when extract_temporal_features attempts to access it.

summary: The agent provides a structurally sound and complex solution featuring strong feature engineering (TF-IDF, SVD, OOF target encoding), a diverse ensemble of models (LGBM, XGB, CatBoost, PyTorch TabularResNet), and an optimized blender. However, it fails to encapsulate feature transformations within the cross-validation loop, resulting in validation leakage. Additionally, an unsafe assumption in the date parsing logic is likely to cause a fatal KeyError during test set prediction if any date column is completely null in the test set.
